'''Anton Gerhard''' "'''Toni'''" '''Hofreiter'''<ref>{{Cite news |last=Schwietering |first=Caspar |last2=Ziedler |first2=Christopher |date=16 December 2023 |title=Hofreiter kritisiert deutsche Ukraine-Politik: 'Die Aussagen des Kanzlers passen nicht immer zu seinem Handeln' |url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/anton-hofreiter-kritisiert-ukrainepolitik-die-worte-des-kanzlers-passen-nicht-zu-seinem-handeln-10931857.html |access-date=2025-02-03 |work=[[Der Tagesspiegel]] |language=de |issn=1865-2263}}</ref> (born 2 February 1970) is a German politician who has been serving as a member of the [[Bundestag]] since the [[2005 German federal election|2005 elections]].

== Political career ==
As a member of [[Alliance 90/The Greens]], Hofreiter has been a member of the [[Bundestag]] since the [[2005 German federal election|2005 elections]]. Between 2005 and 2013, he served as member of the Committee on Transport, Building and Urban Development; he served as chairman of the committee from 2011 until 2013. He was also member of the German-Austrian Parliamentary Friendship Group.

Hofreiter served as co-chair of the [[Green Party faction (Bundestag)|Green Party's parliamentary group]], together with [[Katrin Göring-Eckardt]] from October 2013 to December 2021.<ref>Christina Hebel, [[Christoph Sydow]]: [http://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/katrin-goering-eckardt-und-anton-hofreiter-werden-gruenen-fraktionschefs-a-926745.html '' Fraktionsspitze: Göring-Eckardt gewinnt Kampfabstimmung bei Grünen.''] In: ''[[Spiegel Online]]'', 8. Oktober 2013.</ref> In 2013, he was elected unopposed as the sole candidate of the group's left faction.<ref>Quentin Peel (8 October 2013), [http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/e8307fd6-301c-11e3-9eec-00144feab7de.html Germany Greens set to test waters for possible CDU coalition] ''[[Financial Times]]''.</ref> In September 2019, both Hofreiter and Göring-Eckardt were unsuccessfully challenged by [[Cem Özdemir]] and [[Kirsten Kappert-Gonther]].<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/oezdemirs-gescheiterte-kandidatur-den-versuch-wars-wert/25052114.html |title=Den Versuch war's wert |access-date=28 September 2019 |language=de}}</ref>

In 2011, Hofreiter joined [[Gerhard Schick]], [[Hans-Christian Ströbele]] and [[Winfried Hermann]] in their successful 2011 [[constitutional complaint]] against the refusal of [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]]'s government to provide information on the [[Deutsche Bahn]] and financial market supervision. In its judgment pronounced in 2017, the [[Federal Constitutional Court]] held that the government had indeed failed to fulfil its duty to give answers in response to parliamentary queries and to sufficiently substantiate the reasons.<ref>[http://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2017/bvg17-094.html The Federal Government's refusal to provide information on the Deutsche Bahn AG and financial market supervision was unlawful] [[Federal Constitutional Court]], press release no. 94/2017 of 7 November 2017.</ref>

Since the [[2021 German federal election|2021 elections]], Hofreiter has been serving as chairman of the Committee on European Affairs.<ref>Jonas Schaible (6 December 2021), [https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/hofreiter-soll-vorsitz-im-europaausschuss-uebernehmen-a-3392dba1-d406-43a7-a88f-26ea3a5e1016 Kein Platz im Kabinett: Hofreiter soll Vorsitz im Europaausschuss übernehmen] ''[[Der Spiegel]]''.</ref> In addition to his committee assignments, he has been a member of the German delegation to the [[Franco-German Parliamentary Assembly]] since 2022.<ref>[https://www.bundestag.de/dfpv Franco-German Parliamentary Assembly] [[Bundestag]].</ref>

== Political positions ==
=== Human rights ===
Following 2012 reports by ''[[Spiegel Online]]'' according to which a luxury [[Boeing 767]] belonging to [[List of national leaders of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] was refitted by [[Lufthansa Technik]] in Hamburg with expensive accoutrement to further accommodate Lukashenko's expensive tastes, Hofreiter criticized the company for cooperating with a "dictator who gives orders for the death penalty and violently destroys the opposition".<ref>Quentin Peel (8 October 2013), [https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-lukashenka-boeing-767-germany-luxury/24768845.html] ''[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]]'', 12 November 2012.</ref>

In January 2015, Hofreiter criticized a decision by police in the eastern city of Dresden to ban an anti-Islam march after death threats toward an organizer, slamming the move as a worrying restriction on freedom of speech.<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Torry|first1=Harriet|last2=Troianovski|first2=Anton|author-link2=Anton Troianovski|date=19 January 2015|title=German Lawmakers Slam Police Ban on Pegida Protest|language=en|work=[[The Wall Street Journal]]|location=Berlin|url=https://online.wsj.com/articles/german-lawmakers-slam-police-ban-on-pegida-protest-1421673917|url-access=registration|issn=0099-9660}}</ref> In the [[European migrant crisis|European migration crisis]], Hofreiter is an outspoken proponent of a liberal migration policy.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.stern.de/politik/deutschland/fluechtlingskrise--bund-und-laender-einigen-sich-auf-kostenverteilung-6467130.html|title = Bund übernimmt pro Flüchtling und Monat 670 Euro| date=24 September 2015 }}</ref>

=== European integration ===
In a 2014 debate on a reform of the voting rules in the [[Governing Council of the European Central Bank]], Hofreiter strongly criticized calls for a power of veto, saying to the ''[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]]'': "[[Bundesbank]] chief [[Jens Weidmann]] is not Germany's [[vicegerent]] in the ECB Council".<ref>[http://www.euractiv.com/sections/euro-finance/ecb-voting-rights-rotation-raises-fears-germany-302884 ECB voting rights 'rotation' raises fears in Germany] ''[[EurActiv]]'', 19 June 2014.</ref>
